overhead_analysis.method: existing 100 measured rounds, no new benchmark; pair source and destination by round; durations use their own local monotonic clocks
overhead_analysis.nested_scope_rule: restore includes build; build includes vm_new includes vm_common; no double-counting. Median and p95 stage latencies are not additive.

ept_reuse.direct: mode3 retains same CXL EPT root/SPTE/header graph; PFN check and destination page.private rebind/TLB flush

ept_reuse.hva: equal HVA alone does not preserve GPA-to-HPA EPT entries

overhead_analysis.ept_cost_location: VM/MMU initial state allocation in load; hardware root load at first KVM_RUN and lazy EPT leaf installation on memory access during resume/ACK and later execution
overhead_analysis.not_measured: Prior100-round API-only run did not isolate EPT; follow-up ACK/EPT traces are recorded in ack-ept-breakdown.json. Pure allocation-only CPU time remains unmeasured.
overhead_analysis.ack_caveat: 3.396ms p50 is resume-API-response to heartbeat observation, including scheduling, lazy EPT, guest work and polling; heartbeat precedes16MiB heap verification. Not an EPT cost measurement.
